pre_mortem: It's Monday and the BAL@CLE card lost. Henry: Cleveland's 3.89 YPC front stuffed the outside zone even without Wright, Mitchell and Jackson took the Hill touches plus more, and Henry finished near 16 carries for 58 rush and a handful of receiving yards while Baltimore threw because the game was closer than 7.5. Judkins: the Ravens' 4.88 YPC defense and Higgins's absence let him rip 20 carries in a one-score game, Gabriel did not have to abandon the run, and 84-plus rush yards cashed the over the way his one last4 spike already did. A missing Cleveland weather report could also have turned this into a wetter, lower-efficiency slog that still hit Henry's under if the Ravens never established the lead. If inactives show Henry limited or Collins active and Wright's replacement stuffing the edge, Henry is the cut; if Cleveland's actives show a run-heavy personnel and Green plays, Judkins under is the cut.
